checks.describe: /v1/chat/completions with reasoning_effort=none returns non-empty content in under 200 completion tokens
checks.run: curl -s http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"qwen3.5:2b","reasoning_effort":"none","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say OK"}]}' | jq -r 'if (.choices[0].message.content|length) > 0 and .usage.completion_tokens < 200 then "THINK-OFF-OK" else "THINK-LEAK" end'

checks.describe: /api/generate with think=false returns a non-empty response in under 200 eval tokens
checks.run: curl -s http://localhost:11434/api/generate -d '{"model":"qwen3.5:2b","prompt":"Say OK","stream":false,"think":false}' | jq -r 'if (.response|length) > 0 and .eval_count < 200 then "THINK-OFF-OK" else "THINK-LEAK" end'

checks.describe: containerized client reaches Ollama /v1 through host.docker.internal and gets a chat completion
checks.run: PATH="$HOME/.rd/bin:$PATH" docker compose -f labs/m2/compose.yaml run --rm client

checks.describe: compose down removes the m2 network cleanly (teardown-safe)
